CFB-week.summary: Only one college game in the window: Delaware at Western Kentucky, a Conference USA game on Tuesday Oct 27 at 7 PM ET between two 3-4 teams. As of Monday no named sportsbook or reputable odds page (Covers, the Fox/iHeart betting page, Bleacher Nation) had posted player props for it, so there are no lines to screen. Game lines found: total 55.5-56.5, and both previews quoted have Delaware as the 1.5-point favorite, which is the opposite of the packet's spread_home -1.5.

NBA-ATL-at-HOU-1027.summary: Second half of a home-and-home: Houston won 121-114 in Atlanta Saturday without Fred VanVleet and Steven Adams, out-rebounding the Hawks behind Amen Thompson's 11 boards. VanVleet is off the injury report and available Monday, Adams remains out with a calf strain, and Marcus Smart is questionable with a forearm strain, so the guard minutes Reed Sheppard and Tari Eason picked up Saturday may shrink.

NBA-CHI-at-BOS-1026.summary: Chicago is a 14.5-point underdog (opened 13.5, total about 233) with Nic Claxton out for at least a couple more weeks and Patrick Williams and Noa Essengue questionable after missing Saturday, leaving Jalen Smith as the starting center on a thin frontcourt. Boston plays slow and has been poor on the defensive glass early, while Chicago leads the league in getting to the line but is last in three-point shooting.

NBA-DAL-at-MIA-1026.summary: Miami is 0-3 but has its full roster; Davion Mitchell has been the steadiest piece, starting and closing games while the starting five has the worst net rating of any heavy-use lineup. Dallas is thin on the wing: Naji Marshall (illness) and Caleb Martin (thumb) are out or likely out, Cooper Flagg (mild shoulder sprain) is questionable and expected to sit, while Kyrie Irving returns after resting Saturday.

NBA-GS-at-DEN-1027.summary: Golden State gets Stephen Curry, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green and Al Horford back after all four sat Saturday in Phoenix, which shrinks the roles of the fill-ins who played big minutes there. Gui Santos left that game with left knee tendinitis and is questionable. Denver lists Cameron Johnson and Alpha Diallo as doubtful.

NBA-IND-at-MIL-1027.summary: Indiana plays the second night of a back-to-back after beating Brooklyn, and center Ivica Zubac left on crutches with a sprained ankle (Carlisle called Monday unlikely); McConnell and Sheppard are out, leaving about 10 healthy players with Huff and Nance covering center. Milwaukee (0-3) is healthy, rested Sunday, and outrebounded Philadelphia 62-40 on Saturday. Pacers -4.5, total 239.5.

NBA-MIN-at-CLE-1026.summary: Minnesota plays the second night of a back-to-back after beating Toronto at home Sunday, where LaMelo Ball's early foul trouble pushed Ayo Dosunmu into extended point guard minutes. Cleveland is healthy apart from deep reserves (Tomlin, Diop, Udeh out); no spread had been posted as of Sunday, and no rest decisions for Minnesota were reported.

NBA-WSH-at-CHA-1026.summary: Washington is without No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa (ankle, fourth straight game) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, four weeks), so Trae Young is carrying the creation load and Justin Champagnie is soaking up forward minutes. Charlotte is still missing Kon Knueppel, Coby White, Grant Williams and Kylan Boswell, pushing Dennis Schroder and Sion James into the starting backcourt; Charlotte gave up 128 to Atlanta last week.

NFL-DAL-at-PHI-1027.summary: Philadelphia (2-4, four straight losses) starts Tanner McKee again with Jalen Hurts on IR, and is without WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks, edge Nolan Smith and slot CB Michael Carter; Greenard missed Friday and Saturday practice. Barkley is reported set to return from a two-game hamstring absence with Bigsby and Shipley on IR. Dallas is -4.5 (opened -5.5), total 43.5-44, and is missing OT Drew Shelton and WR KaVontae Turpin.

NFL-KC-at-SEA-1026.summary: Seattle is missing linebackers Drake Thomas and Chazz Surratt and has three more front-seven players questionable, which helps Kansas City's run game with Kenneth Walker III.
